mb45_group: L1 right-hand non-thumb, same row, adjacent, MB4 left of MB5

scroll_bindings.additional_layer_rules: distinct layers outside L0, L1, and frozen L7; each targets its containing layer; non-thumb; never an essential access edge

mouse_lock: reachable L1 self-toggle/lock from the L0 L1 hold; lock persists after hold release
ordinary_hold_reachability: every generated layer L1-L10 except frozen L7 has an ordinary momentary path from L0; scroll bindings are excluded
thumb_clearance: for every reachable ordinary momentary thumb hold, including same-layer holds, on its target layer each thumb side held along an access path contains only empty or return-to-L0 bindings; toggles and locks never waive this rule; L7 is exempt
required_shortcut_placement: These shortcuts must remain on legal L1 non-thumb positions outside the top row, with physical effort at most 1.0. Usage, effort, and familiarity score alternative placements within that legal set.
required_semantic_cluster_layouts: Every semantic cluster with declared nonzero relative offsets must retain its exact relative placement.
